title: DC-area forecast: Hottest day of the week before storms become more widespread
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: It's the hottest day of the week. Morning temperatures in the 70s and 80s climb into the low to mid-90s this afternoon. A few pop-up storms are possible late.

What’s next? Shower and thunderstorm chances increase Tuesday and Wednesday while it remains hot and muggy. Temperatures and humidity ease somewhat later in the week.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: With a chance to hit 95 degrees and storms possible, too, I wouldn't mind taking a pass on today's weather. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Monday): Plenty of sunshine should push highs into the low to mid-90s. Factoring in the humidity (dew points near 70), it'll feel closer to 100 this afternoon. By late afternoon, there's about a 30 percent chance of a shower or thunderstorm, with the highest chances across our western area. Winds are light from the south. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Widely scattered evening showers and storms are possible. Otherwise, expect a partly cloudy and muggy summer night, with lows from around 70 in the cooler suburbs to the mid-70s downtown. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): Variably cloudy, very warm and humid, with dew points in the low 70s and highs around 90. Showers and thunderstorms are more likely than on Monday, and a few could become strong to severe. While storms are most likely during the afternoon and evening, a few could develop earlier in the day. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and thunderstorms remain possible, especially during the evening. Otherwise, skies are mostly cloudy with muggy lows from 70 to 75. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday and Thursday look fairly similar, with partly sunny skies, continued moderate to high humidity and highs near 90. Each day brings a chance of late afternoon and evening showers and thunderstorms. Nights remain muggy, with lows generally between 70 and 75. Confidence: Medium

Friday into the weekend turns somewhat less hot and humid as dew points fall into the 60s. Highs should mainly reach the mid-80s, with overnight lows in the mid-60s to near 70. Skies are generally partly sunny, with only a slight chance of an afternoon or evening shower or thunderstorm each day. Confidence: Low-Medium
